verdict.rationale: Maritime's own ready-made templates deploy pre-configured agents with no code. They use Maritime's metered LLM access by default, so you can talk to them and hand off tasks such as scheduling a weekday digest or migrating workloads off another provider. These are agents the user deploys from templates rather than an assistant embedded in the product's own interface, and the evidence never describes one. Missing for 10: an in-product assistant built into the dashboard or UI, documentation of what tasks it can operate on within Maritime itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Deploy a complete agent from a template and talk to it, in under 5 minutes. No code.
tell it "send me a digest every weekday at 9" and the platform syncs the schedule it sets for itself into real wake triggers.
point Claude Code or your Maritime agent at a provider's runbook page and it can inventory the old provider with read-only credentials, recreate each workload as a Maritime agent
No key is required: the agent uses Maritime's metered LLM access by default.
